jobs.title: Study in Türkiye – Agency Final Quiz
strings: Study in Türkiye – Agency Final Quiz
This quiz checks advisor understanding of key topics about studying in Türkiye, including programs, admissions, housing, visas, work rules and student life.
According to the academic quality guidelines, how are many programs in Türkiye described as assessing students?
Only with one final exam at the end of the degree, with no projects.
By attendance only, with no exams or assignments.
Using verbal exams only, with no written work.
Through outcome-based curricula with continuous assessment such as projects, midterms and finals.
Which combination is mentioned as part of Türkiye’s career and employability support for students?
A guaranteed permanent government job for every graduate regardless of field.
Lifetime free accommodation for all international students.
Internships and practical training embedded in many programs, active career centers and regional networking thanks to Türkiye’s strategic location.
Remote-only internships abroad with no local connections.
Vocational schools (MYO) in Türkiye typically offer two-year associate programs focused on applied skills such as health technician, IT support or logistics.
In Türkiye, a preparatory (Prep) year is always counted inside the official duration of the degree program and does not add extra time.
Which city is described as having a coastal, vibrant Mediterranean lifestyle with tram/metro networks and an active social life along the seaside?
Istanbul
Ankara
Izmir
Bursa
According to the advisor matching tips, which factors should be discussed with students when shortlisting districts or cities?
Only the nightlife options in each city.
Language preference (TR/EN), budget, preferred climate and class commute tolerance.
Exclusively proximity to large shopping malls.
Only the visa processing times for each country.
Which feature is highlighted for Engineering & IT programs in Türkiye?
No access to laboratories or internships.
Language study only, without any mathematics.
Only theoretical lectures with no practical components.
Capstone projects with industry, hackathons, incubators and tech parks.
For public (state) universities, a national exam for internationals known as TRYÖS (TRYOS) is typically required for admission.
Which of the following is explicitly listed as part of Social Sciences & Humanities fields?
Veterinary Medicine
Mechanical Engineering
International Relations
Aviation Management
What is the typical ECTS load for a two-year Associate (Short Cycle) degree in Türkiye?
Approximately 120 ECTS
Approximately 240 ECTS
Approximately 60–120 ECTS for Master’s
Program-defined with no reference to ECTS
Which program is given as an example of a long-cycle profession in the Turkish higher education structure?
Medicine
Computer Science
Tourism Management
Media & Communication
At the portal application stage, documents that are in English or contain English content are generally accepted for evaluation if they are clear scans or PDFs.
Which statement about English-medium (EN) programs is correct according to the language requirements section?
The usual entry level is B2 English, with exemption often possible via tests such as TOEFL iBT around 70–72+, PTE 55+ or a university proficiency exam.
No formal English proof is ever required because all students take Prep Year.
Only C2 English is accepted for any English-medium program.
Only A1 English is required and no certificates are needed.
Which of the following is NOT listed as a way to obtain exemption from a language preparatory year?
Passing the university’s own language proficiency exam.
Providing an accepted external language certificate according to university policy.
Demonstrating previous schooling in the language of instruction with official evidence.
Writing a generic motivational letter about wanting to study abroad.
For residence permit applications, students are advised to keep both digital and printed copies of documents such as passports, address proof, insurance policies and fee receipts.
In the private (foundation) university flow, what is the step immediately after receiving the Conditional Pre-Acceptance?
Pay the university deposit and upload the deposit payment receipt for verification.
Enroll on campus in person with original documents.
Apply directly for a residence permit.
Book the graduation ceremony date.
Which statement best describes the service fee policy for public (state) universities?
In cases of visa refusal or no-show / non-arrival, the service fee is non-refundable and fully chargeable.
The service fee is always refunded in full if the visa is refused.
There is no service or consultancy fee for public universities.
The service fee is paid directly to students as a scholarship.
What does the visa overview advise regarding travel purchases before the visa is issued?
Always buy the cheapest non-refundable flight ticket before applying.
Purchase a flight ticket first, then consider the visa application later.
Plan timelines conservatively and avoid non-refundable travel purchases until the visa is issued.
Non-refundable tickets are required by consulates for student visas.
In the cost-of-living guide, dormitories are described as having more complex contracts than apartments and usually excluding utilities from the monthly cost.
Regulated fields such as Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy, Nursing and Law may require licensing or equivalence procedures in the student’s home or target country.
Which of the following is mentioned as a hidden or extra cost students should watch for when budgeting accommodation?
Free campus cafeteria meals guaranteed for all students.
Complimentary weekly apartment cleaning for every tenant.
Winter heating costs, apartment deposits and move-in fees.
Automatic refund of deposits without any conditions.
In the residence permit quick reference table, which document is specifically linked to residence eligibility?
The health insurance policy that meets local criteria.
A campus library membership card.
A gym membership from a private fitness center.
An exam transcript from the student’s home university.
Associate and Bachelor students in Türkiye are allowed to work part-time from their first semester without needing to complete any academic year.
According to the cost-of-living guide, which approach can help students reduce food expenses?
Eating only in full-service restaurants every day.
Using a mix of campus cafeterias, home cooking and local markets.
Buying only imported packaged foods.
Relying exclusively on vending machines on campus.
Which feature distinguishes a curricular (for-credit) internship from extra-curricular experience in the internship overview?
It is always informal and never documented by the university.
It is guaranteed to be unpaid and does not involve any evaluation.
It is only available after graduation and not during studies.
It is listed in the syllabus with defined learning outcomes, supervisor evaluations and reports.
